What the record shows

Between July and October 2026 Nebius signed, announced or was reported to be planning capacity in the Netherlands, Wales, Estonia, Finland and the United States 3,4,6,8,9, and raised a first senior secured facility followed by an upsized $5 billion debt raise against more than $40 billion of customer commitments 11,7.

Dated Signals

Oct 12, 2026W.Media

First off-taker for VOLT in Rotterdam

Nebius signed a letter of intent to become the first off-taker at VOLT's Dutch AI Gigafactory in Rotterdam 3.

Oct 2, 2026W.Media

50 MW with AIB Data Centers

AIB Data Centers entered a binding 12-year agreement with Nebius for 50 MW of critical IT capacity at its southeastern US facility 4.

Oct 2, 2026IndexBox

Fuel cells for Vineland, New Jersey

Nebius endorsed Bloom Energy's solid oxide fuel cells for its planned 300 MW AI data center in Vineland, New Jersey, citing faster deployment and less community opposition than gas turbines 5.

Sep 29, 2026Data Center Dynamics

Estonia and a second Finnish site

Nebius signed with Greenergy Data Centers for 22 MW in Hüüru, Estonia, as part of a €50 million expansion, and announced a second facility in Mäntsälä, Finland 6.

Aug 24, 2026W.Media · Data Centre Review

From $775 million to $5 billion of debt

Nebius raised $775 million through its first senior secured debt facility in July 11, then upsized a debt raise to $5 billion; it could spend up to $25 billion this year to meet more than $40 billion of customer commitments 7.

Aug 19, 2026Nebius (post-mortem)

Storm takes out cooling in us-central1

A storm-related event disabled the chilled-water cooling at Nebius's us-central1 facility, triggering thermal shutdowns across servers, switches and rack power systems 10.

Aug 14, 2026Capacity

First South Wales AI Growth Zone deployment

Nebius agreed to lease high-density, Nvidia-powered capacity at Vantage Data Centers' CWL1 campus in Newport 8.

Jul 28, 2026W.Media

A 1.2 GW campus in Pennsylvania, reported

Nebius is reportedly planning a 1.2 GW campus at Highridge Business Park in Butler Township, Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania 9.
